title: Page kinds and their structure — living-docs capability
description: Formal shape of the capability's `schemas/page-kinds.yaml`: each page kind it ships, keyed by the kind a page names in its `kind` field, with the structure the kind's pages follow (living-docs DEC-001 point 3; RS-LDOC-004) — the sections a page's body carries, in order unless the kind says otherwise. The one declaration of each kind's structure: the validator, `pkit living-docs validate`, checks every page of the kind against it, at the severity the status of RS-LDOC-004 gives, and a kind not listed is not checked. Capability data, read by the capability's own scripts; not adopter data.

kinds.description: The page kinds, keyed by kind; each kind's template is `templates/<kind>.md`.

word.description: A page kind, as a page's `kind` field names it (`schemas/page.schema.json`).

sections.description: The sections a page of the kind carries. Each takes a heading of its own; a page may carry other sections besides.

ordered.description: Whether the sections come in the order listed. True unless set to false.

section.title: One section: a heading's level and, where the kind fixes it, its text
section.description: A Markdown ATX heading — one to six `#` — outside fenced code. A section without `text` is one the writer words, as the template's `<placeholder>` heading; text is compared ignoring case, runs of white space and trailing punctuation.

level.description: The heading's level: the number of `#`.
